races.name: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Trooper
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up performer for Neil Mulholland who drops back from his last two runs over 13f and 9f to a more suitable 16f; recent form is modest (654-74) and his history over longer trips on good to soft ground suggests he needs more give than Standard AW provides, though going is flagged OK — likely to be positioned in rear and needs the pace to collapse in front of him, which this shape does not encourage.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and ranked ninth of ten on our figures, Trooper has a stiff task here; 42 days off the track adds a fitness question, though he has at least been running to a fairly consistent level.

runners_data.name: Balgowan
runners_data.note: The strongest course-and-distance profile in the race, with two wins over 16f at Lingfield AW on Standard going and consistent placed efforts at this venue; Jeff Mullins sends him here 40 days fresh and George Downing rides, and his natural prominent style means he should sit in second or third behind Femme Fatale — the ideal tactical position in this race shape.
runners_data.comment: Balgowan arrives in fine fettle after back-to-back runner-up finishes, with a win three starts back and experience over today's trip and ground working in his favour; the 40-day absence is the one query.

runners_data.name: Man Of The Sea
runners_data.note: A ten-year-old veteran for Neil Mulholland, lightly framed at OR 52 with a tongue-tie and visor, whose natural game is hold-up racing; shunted into midfield on the map because the field is loaded with closers and he cannot realistically get the rear position he wants — the style fit discount (0.93) and his age are both relevant headwinds in a race that will reward prominence.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and a modest official mark of 52 counts against him, but 24 days since his last run leaves him fresh and he has run over today's going before; the fourth last time out, and a fourth two starts back, hints at some consistency without troubling the judge.

runners_data.name: Si White
runners_data.note: Sir Mark Prescott's three-year-old steps up to his longest trip yet and arrives here fresh off a win 9 days ago, already showing course form on Standard AW (1W2P in five runs on the surface); despite being a hold-up type, his course fitness edge and the Prescott operation's precision with timing suggest he warrants respect, and the step to 2m on this surface looks logical rather than ambitious.
runners_data.comment: Third last time out following a win two starts back, Si White arrives in sharp form with just nine days between runs and a trainer firing at 27% over the past fortnight. He has run over today's going before and carries 131 lb.

runners_data.name: Femme Fatale
runners_data.note: James Tate's filly carries a STYLE_FIT flag (0.92) because her profile is more hold-up than pure front-runner in class terms, yet she is the confirmed pace-setter here — if she finds the lead without pressure she controls the shape of the whole race; her only win on Standard AW (1/6 runs) came over this exact trip and the lone front-runner role gives her a tactical edge that her bare OR of 59 does not fully reflect.
runners_data.comment: Femme Fatale shaped with promise when runner-up last time out and has run over today's trip and going, giving her a solid grounding — the main risk is that she remains winless in her last five starts.

runners_data.name: Sir Griflet
runners_data.note: Dylan Cunha's three-year-old is wearing a tongue-tie and cheekpieces and has form on Standard AW, but his last six results show a zero-from-eight record at this level and a 600 (pulled up) on his most recent start; hold-up racing over 12f is his background and the step to 2m with poor recent form makes him a very speculative participant in this shape.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts, Sir Griflet nonetheless rates as a leading danger on our figures, carrying 127 lb off an official mark of 55 — that rating gap could prove significant; the risk is his two consecutive unplaced efforts heading in.

runners_data.name: Fabled Spirit
runners_data.note: Archie Watson's three-year-old arrives just eight days after his last run and carries a finishing-fade warning alongside his redistribution tag — in his natural rear-drawn role he tends to come up short in the final furlong, which is the last thing a hold-up horse needs when racing in an artificial midfield position; 14f on Fibresand last time was his best effort (3rd) but the application to AW on Standard and the fade flag are both concerns at 2m.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts, Fabled Spirit does at least bring a third-place finish last time out as encouragement, though an unplaced effort before that dampens confidence; fit on an eight-day turnaround, he faces a stiff ask off 126 lb.

runners_data.name: Last Flight
runners_data.note: James Horton's three-year-old has his best form over 14f on Standard AW (3rd at Lingfield) and has been stepping up in trip through his career — 2m is a new ceiling; held up naturally, he sits in a redistributed midfield berth that flatters his likely real position, and a 0W from 7 runs tells its own story, though if the race is run at a strong clip he is the hold-up horse most likely to finish into a place.
runners_data.comment: Showed her best recent form with a third last time out after a fifth and a run of sevenths, and she has experience of today's going — but winless in her last five starts and rated 53 officially, she faces a stiff task from sixth in the rankings.

runners_data.name: October Surprise
runners_data.note: Sheena West's three-year-old has only one run beyond a mile (5th over 16f at Lingfield on Standard, which is at least course-relevant) but arrives with a fading-finish flag and an OR of just 46; held up by nature but forced into midfield on the map, she looks exposed in terms of form and the drop to OR 46 reflects that — connections send her here on minimum notice with a stable in quiet form (0/2 over 14 days).
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, with finishes no better than fifth in recent outings, October Surprise is hard to fancy on these figures — though he has run over today's trip and going before, and 33 days off may have freshened him up.

runners_data.name: Make A Splash
runners_data.note: Tom Ward's lightly-raced three-year-old has just three runs to her name, all over shorter (10f-14f) and all finishing in the bottom half of the field; the step to 2m looks ambitious for a horse whose limited form shows a fade tendency, and the stable is in quiet form (1/11 over 14 days) — her redistribution from rear to midfield on the map means she is unlikely to be racing in a comfortable role, and her chance in any of the four scenarios is marginal.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last three starts, with finishes of ninth, sixth, and eighth showing little improvement, Make A Splash looks up against it here — though a 19-day turnaround at least suggests she arrives fresh, and she carries just 117 lb.

races.paceDynamic: Femme Fatale is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 10-runner, 2-mile AW handicap at Lingfield and, crucially, she is largely uncontested — she should bowl along at a controlled, sustainable tempo and dictate throughout from the front. With just one pace-setter setting an honest but unhurried gallop over this stamina trip, the race is unlikely to turn into a true test of attrition, meaning those who can travel close to the pace and produce their effort from off the shoulder of the leader hold the clearest tactical advantage. The field is heavily loaded with hold-up horses — Fabled Spirit, Last Flight, Man Of The Sea, October Surprise and Make A Splash are all true hold-up types that have been redistributed to the midfield on the map because they cannot all race from the rear in practice — meaning genuine closers will be bunched in traffic and may struggle to produce the kind of late surge that a truly-run race would invite. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those who can travel in second or third, keeping tabs on Femme Fatale before challenging in the straight, rather than horses who depend on a fast early pace collapsing in front of them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Femme Fatale Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Femme Fatale travels smoothly in front, sets a fair but uncontested gallop, and the hold-up horses cannot mount a coordinated late challenge.
scenarios.body: Femme Fatale dictates from flag to finish and, with her nearest pursuer Balgowan tracking from a prominent position, the pair are in the best possible place as the field strings out over the final half-mile; horses ridden from deep in the pack simply cannot reel in a comfortable front-runner over a trip this long at Lingfield AW. Prominent or close-tracking profiles benefit most — any horse who takes a positive position within the first two furlongs is well-placed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Picks Off Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Balgowan or Si White tracks Femme Fatale closely and produces superior stamina to wear her down in the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: Balgowan has strong course-and-distance form on this surface and at this trip, having won over 16f at Lingfield on Standard going, and his jockey George Downing can afford to sit second or third and pounce as Femme Fatale ties up; Si White, stepping up in trip on a surface where he has already won, is another who suits a prominent role and could benefit from a late swoop off a steady gallop. Both profiles reward horses that can travel smoothly and avoid traffic in a field where the majority are held up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If Femme Fatale goes off too fast for the distance or falters in the final furlong, leaving a gap for a closer to sprint through.
scenarios.body: This scenario requires the midfield bunch — Last Flight, Man Of The Sea, or Trooper — to find a clear run and produce a finishing burst, but given that most of the hold-up horses in this race are redistributed types rather than natural closers and the pace is unlikely to be truly strong enough to set them up, the winning margin is expected to favour those closer to the front. Last Flight's course form and recent placed effort over this trip gives it the best credentials from this group, but the scenario carries meaningful doubt.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Field Bunches
scenarios.trigger: If Femme Fatale sets a dawdling pace and the field concertinas in the straight, turning the race into a flat-out sprint from two furlongs out.
scenarios.body: A truly slow early gallop could negate stamina advantages and turn the final furlong into a sprint, which in theory helps those with sharper finishing gears regardless of position, but at 2 miles on AW with this set of runners, most horses lack the raw pace to capitalise and the form book points away from sprint finishes; Balgowan and Si White, who have shown they can respond when a race quickens up, are again best-placed if this shape materialises, though the probability of a true pace collapse with Femme Fatale confirmed as front-runner is low.

watchPoints.text: Balgowan — watch whether George Downing takes up second or third position behind Femme Fatale inside the first half-mile; if he tracks the leader comfortably on the inner, his course-and-distance record makes him a primary danger throughout.

Femme Fatale — monitor the early pace she sets; if she is allowed to bowl along unchallenged at a sensible clip she becomes very hard to catch over 2m, but any sign she is overdoing it in the first mile could trigger Scenario C and open the race up for closers.

Si White — watch the jockey's positioning off the gate; Luke Morris is an experienced handler of Prescott horses and if he is seen travelling well in fourth or fifth at the halfway mark on a horse with five runs on this surface, his improving profile is worth tracking into the straight.

Last Flight and Man Of The Sea — both are hold-up types mapped to midfield and will likely be further back than the race map suggests; if the pace is truly slow, they may be too far off the bridle in the straight to launch an effective challenge and can be monitored for position early to assess whether the race shape even gives them a chance.

Fabled Spirit — track her early position; she carries a fade flag and a redistribution note, and if she is last or second-last at halfway she is very unlikely to get competitive in a race where the front-runner is uncontested.

races.name: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Arctic Wind
runners_data.note: Trainer David Evans knows this horse well, but a hold-up style that has produced only one placed effort in seven runs on similar going (2/7, 0W1P) is a concern; naturally a closer who will be shuffled into a contested midfield berth rather than finding a clean lane at the rear, tempering confidence.
runners_data.comment: Third three starts back, and third again two starts back, Arctic Wind brings a stack of placed form to this contest and has experience of both today's trip and going; drawn in stall six carrying 131 lb, the main concern is that seventh last time out after a 37-day break.

runners_data.name: Wyle Cop
runners_data.note: Jason Watson rides a horse whose recent form string (009355) offers little encouragement, and while blinkers are fitted to sharpen focus, the five-furlong trip at Lingfield on Standard has produced just one win from thirteen attempts on comparable going; a genuine closer forced to share the chasing group with four similar types.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts, with a pair of fifths and a third his only recent encouragement, Wyle Cop faces a stiff ask from stall one carrying 131 lb — though he has run over today's trip and going before and is fit enough at 21 days between runs.

runners_data.name: Go Lockers Go
runners_data.note: Michael Bell's yard is in fair form (1/25 in 14 days) and this horse's form figures of 112258 show a recent winner who understands how to hit the line — having run on this exact surface over five furlongs just eight days ago, recency and course-distance fitness make this one of the more credible challengers from the chasing pack despite racing in a congested group.
runners_data.comment: A second four starts back and a winner five starts back give Go Lockers Go a solid recent profile, and he returns quickly on a trip and going he has encountered before — the concern is a trainer badly out of form at 1/25 in the last fortnight.

runners_data.name: Sunlit Sea
runners_data.note: Sir Mark Prescott's operation sends out a horse fitted with blinkers for the first time and carrying two recent wins on Good ground (1/5f/GOO, 1/5f/GOO), though Standard Polytrack form is thin with just four placed efforts from eleven runs on comparable going and no wins; the headgear change is the key angle to monitor.
runners_data.comment: Ranked bottom of the field on our figures and carrying a stiff 130 lb, Sunlit Sea faces a stern task, though back-to-back wins in her last two starts and a trainer firing at 27% offer genuine encouragement; she has run over today's trip and going before.

runners_data.name: Carefree Dream
runners_data.note: Taylor Fisher takes the mount for J S Moore on a horse that has placed four times in its last six outings without winning, suggesting a consistent but not decisive finisher; the 5f trip at Lingfield on Standard represents a viable scenario, but the form ceiling of this hold-up runner has been tested repeatedly without a breakthrough.
runners_data.comment: Carefree Dream ran a fine second three starts back and is back quickly on 15 days' rest, with experience over today's trip and going working in her favour; the risk is that she has been winless in recent starts and dropped to sixth last time out.

runners_data.name: Guernsey Lady
runners_data.note: J F Egan partners a David Evans-trained three-year-old returning after 65 days off and mapped to the front as the race's only credible pace-setter despite being a natural prominent-to-hold-up type — the redistribution is significant, and while the solo lead is structurally advantageous, the 65-day absence and out-of-role position mean confidence must be tempered; zero wins on Standard going from thirteen runs is a material flag.
runners_data.comment: Guernsey Lady has been consistently placed in recent starts, finishing second last time out and third two starts back, and she has experience of today's distance and going. Drawn in stall two carrying 132 lb, she looks the one to beat despite being winless in her last five.

races.paceDynamic: Guernsey Lady is the only confirmed pace-setter in this six-runner sprint, redistributed to the front having been identified as the most likely pace-maker from a field in which every other runner is a natural hold-up type. With no genuine rival for the lead, she is set to dictate a solo, uncontested gallop over the five-furlong Lingfield Polytrack, controlling tempo without pressure throughout. The field holds considerably more hold-up horses than can realistically operate from the rear — Wyle Cop, Arctic Wind, Go Lockers Go, Sunlit Sea, and Carefree Dream are all true closers competing for the same ground, and at least two or three will be forced to race further forward than they would naturally choose. In a race where one horse controls from the front and the closers are bunched in a congested chasing pack unable to all find cover, this shape is most likely to reward either the pace-setter if the tempo is sustainable, or the hold-up horse with the strongest finishing kick who can thread through from the group — but with such pace compression behind her, the race-shaper Guernsey Lady holds a structurally privileged position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Guernsey Lady Controls Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Guernsey Lady is allowed to dictate an uncontested, measured gallop and the closers fail to co-ordinate a sufficiently powerful late run.
scenarios.body: Guernsey Lady sets a sustainable pace from the front without a single rival willing to apply pressure, conserving enough energy to hold on through the final furlong as the closers arrive too late or in too disorganised a fashion.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strongest Closer Nails It
scenarios.trigger: If the pace Guernsey Lady sets is slightly too strong through the early and middle portions, giving the best finisher among the chasing group a chance to nail her close home.
scenarios.body: One of the more powerful hold-up runners generates the strongest late surge from the chasing pack as Guernsey Lady ties up in the final fifty yards, with the winner likely to be the horse showing the best recent form on this surface.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Blanket Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Guernsey Lady misjudges the tempo and goes too fast too soon, setting up a truly compressed finish where the entire chasing pack arrives simultaneously.
scenarios.body: The closers benefit from a stop-start rhythm as Guernsey Lady fades sharply in the final furlong, but with five horses representing the same style, the winner is likely to be whichever draws the clearest run through traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Guernsey Lady produces a career-best front-running effort and the hold-up horses are trapped in a gridlocked bunch with no clear passage.
scenarios.body: All five hold-up runners obstruct one another through the final two furlongs, and Guernsey Lady, benefiting from the cleanest air and undisturbed rhythm, simply extends her lead to an unassailable margin.

watchPoints.text: Guernsey Lady's 65-day absence combined with racing out of her natural style on the front end — watch for any sign of greenness or reluctance to stride on early, which would collapse the dominant scenario entirely.

Go Lockers Go ran just eight days ago and arrives as the freshest form horse in the field — watch whether Ross Coakley can find a clean passage through the congested chasing group, as traffic trouble is the primary risk to this runner's chance.

Sunlit Sea's first-time blinkers for Sir Mark Prescott are a live angle — watch the paddock and early stalls behaviour, as headgear changes from this yard frequently signal a horse about to improve markedly.

With five hold-up horses competing for the same ground, watch the draw and early positioning — any runner that can secure the widest clear run from the chasing pack without being boxed in by rivals racing out of role will enjoy a meaningful advantage.

Wyle Cop's blinkers are retained but the horse has failed to win in twelve attempts on similar going — watch whether the early pace set by Guernsey Lady is strong enough to bring this hold-up type into contention, or whether the moderate tempo leaves the field too bunched for a finisher of this profile.

races.name: Bay Gardens Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: V Power
runners_data.note: Won over 1m4f on Standard Polytrack 3 days ago and steps up to 1m5f here; sole confirmed pace-setter who will dictate this race uncontested, though racing style fit at 0.93 notes a positional stretch — his record over similar distances and going is solid enough to be respected as the controlling force.|
runners_data.comment: V Power won two starts back and has experience of today's trip and conditions, with our rating putting him right in contention as one of the leading dangers — the concern is that fifth last time out and the quick three-day turnaround may catch up with him.

runners_data.name: Shopaholic
runners_data.note: Best form came when second over 1m4f on Standard going and now steps up to 1m5f, which should suit this hold-up type; trainer Jack Jones has a modest 14-day record but the mare's form on Standard surfaces looks the most relevant of any horse coming from off the pace.|
runners_data.comment: Shopaholic shaped with plenty of encouragement when runner-up last time out, and has run over today's trip and going before; winless in her last four starts is the concern, but that recent second suggests she's knocking on the door.

runners_data.name: Artavian
runners_data.note: Prominent-racing type who tracked leaders and finished placed over 1m2f on Standard going; Lingfield's flat circuit suits his style, has run consistently in a minor key, and could benefit most directly from a V Power-controlled race as the natural chaser of the pace.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Artavian does bring distance and going experience, and 33 days between runs suggests he arrives fresh; a third two starts back offers mild encouragement, but a rating of 55 and a mid-pack ranking leave him with plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Halimede
runners_data.note: Sir Mark Prescott's three-year-old, active just 4 days ago, has winning form over 1m4f on Good ground but has faded repeatedly in finishes on the All-Weather; genuinely holds up at the rear but the map places him in midfield given the density of hold-up types — don't mistake that position for a natural tactical preference, and the finishing fade flag is a real concern at this trip.|
runners_data.comment: Halimede bounced back to winning form last time out and has experience over today's trip and going, with her trainer firing at 27% in the last fortnight. Four days between runs is quick, but the yard's current form makes that less of a concern.

runners_data.name: Parc Dosne
runners_data.note: Lightly raced three-year-old by Kyle McHugh (7lb claimer) stepping up sharply from 1m2f on Good ground; true hold-up runner with no evidence yet of handling Standard Polytrack and the trip extension is speculative, though youth and unexposed profile leave a sliver of upside.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last three starts, Parc Dosne has finished no better than fourth in recent outings and our figures rank him last of seven here; the 131 lb burden does him no favours either, though at least a 22-day break suggests he arrives fresh.

runners_data.name: Darkest Red
runners_data.note: Consistently placed at 1m2f-1m4f on Good and Soft ground — five consecutive placed runs — but a confirmed hold-up type whose natural rear position is squeezed in this field; Pat Cosgrave is a smart tactical rider but the horse's complete absence of winning form and AW inexperience on Standard are limiting factors.|
runners_data.comment: Darkest Red has been knocking on the door, posting three seconds in his last five starts, and has experience of today's trip and conditions — our rating just about puts him top of this field. The concern is that he remains winless in recent starts, suggesting the winning thread is proving elusive.

runners_data.name: Cospicua
runners_data.note: Two wins over 1m4f on Standard Polytrack show genuine course-and-distance credentials, and James Tate's stable has been active with three winners from 13 in 14 days; returning from 58 days off is a query, and as a true hold-up type mapped into midfield due to field congestion, she will need the pace to collapse to bring her finishing effort into play.|
runners_data.comment: Consecutive sixth-place finishes in her last two starts make Cospicua hard to fancy, and she ranks sixth of seven on our figures; a 58-day absence adds to the concern, though she has winning form in recent starts and experience of today's distance and going.

races.paceDynamic: V Power is the sole confirmed front-runner and, with no meaningful pressure expected from the rest of the field, should dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop throughout the 1m5f trip on Lingfield's flat Polytrack surface. Artavian is the only other prominent-style runner, likely to track V Power through the early stages, while Shopaholic, Halimede, Darkest Red, Cospicua, and Parc Dosne all carry hold-up profiles — though Halimede, Darkest Red, and Cospicua are redistributed into midfield on the map simply because the rear is overcrowded with true hold-up types, not because they will naturally race there. With one pace-setter controlling fractions unopposed and the rest of the field bunched behind, the race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent-racing profiles: an uncontested V Power can set an honest but manageable tempo and may prove very hard to peg back over this trip if the closers leave too much to do. The hold-up contingent face the dual problem of covering extra ground and needing a meaningful injection of pace late — neither of which is guaranteed when the leader has had things entirely their own way.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: V Power Controls Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If V Power leads from the outset and faces zero pressure from Artavian or the hold-up pack to increase the tempo.
scenarios.body: V Power dictates a comfortable, uncontested gallop and the field has no mechanism to force him into a gruelling pace, allowing him to conserve energy and sprint clear in the straight; Artavian, tracking closely throughout, is best placed of the remainder to pick up any scraps if V Power tires near the line.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Outstays Field
scenarios.trigger: If V Power sets a fast enough gallop to stretch the field but ultimately ties up, allowing Artavian to stride past in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Artavian, having tracked the pace throughout without expending early energy, inherits the lead as V Power falters and sees out the 1m5f trip comfortably; Shopaholic, stepping up from shorter trips, could benefit from the honest fractions to make late ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closers Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If V Power goes off hard enough to tire and leaves the door ajar for the genuine hold-up horses to deliver a sustained late run.
scenarios.body: Shopaholic has the best form at the trip on Standard going and could sweep through late if the pace collapses; Darkest Red has been running consistently placed and Cospicua has won twice over 1m4f-1m5f on similar surfaces, making both viable beneficiaries of a strong pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset From Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the race completely unravels tactically and all principals fail to produce their best form on the day.
scenarios.body: Parc Dosne, lightly raced at three and still potentially unexposed at this trip, could emerge from obscurity if the senior horses underperform; Halimede, trained by Sir Mark Prescott who has a strong record with improving youngsters, could outrun market expectations if this longer trip unlocks improvement.

watchPoints.text: Watch V Power in the early stages — if he is allowed to stride clear unchallenged at a steady pace, the race may effectively be over before the field enters the straight.
Monitor Halimede's finish closely; flagged as a horse that fades late and returning just 4 days after a run, any sign of early effort could burn through reserves before the line.

Darkest Red has placed on five consecutive starts without winning — watch whether Pat Cosgrave attempts a more assertive tactical ride to break that pattern, which could alter the race shape unexpectedly.

Cospicua's 58-day absence is worth noting pre-race; if she shows any signs of rustiness coming out of the stalls or through the early stages, her hold-up profile makes recovery from a tardy break almost impossible in a small field.

The 7lb claiming riders on V Power (Zoe Lewis) and Parc Dosne (Kyle McHugh) are worth watching for positional errors — any misjudgement of pace from Lewis in particular could either gift the race to V Power or set it up perfectly for the closers.

races.name: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Kanzi
runners_data.note: Won on debut over 7f at Goodwood on good ground and steps up in trip here; natural front-runner for Charlie Johnston, Callum Shepherd takes the ride, and the step to a mile on AW should suit, though OR=120 means she faces level-weight rivals and must lead to be at her best.

runners_data.name: Norfolk Dream
runners_data.note: Beaten eighth on debut over 7f at Lingfield AW (Standard) for William Knight, a hold-up type who fades in the finish — the sim-going record of 0W0P here is a red flag and she will need a stronger pace than Kanzi is likely to set to get competitive.

runners_data.name: Ozone Friendly
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with unknown running style for James Owen, going preference unclear and race fitness uncertain given no LR figure — Harry Davies rides and this filly is essentially an unknown quantity who could profile anywhere in the field.

runners_data.name: Saffron Bay
runners_data.note: Second entry with completely unknown style and trip preference for Charles Hills, Rob Hornby in the saddle and lightly raced profile means she is a pure wildcard — Charles Hills has just 3 wins from 20 in the 14-day window which tempers enthusiasm slightly.

runners_data.name: Senorita Luna
runners_data.note: Hold-up filly who finished seventh on debut over 7f at Lingfield AW (Standard) for Marco Botti, with Benoit de la Sayette booked; the 0W0P sim-going record and 18-day gap since that run raise questions about whether she can improve enough to threaten from the back of this field.

runners_data.name: Amethyst Star
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for Eve Johnson Houghton who has form figures of 10 and 7 over shorter trips on Good and Soft ground, so the switch to AW Standard and step up to a mile is a significant change of context — Callum Hutchinson rides and she is the best-placed horse to exploit Kanzi's lead if she travels well.

runners_data.name: Chaise Longue
runners_data.note: Ed Dunlop's filly holds a genuine hold-up style and returned an eighth on debut over 7f at Goodwood (Good) 30 days ago; shown at midfield on the pace map because more closers in this field than can all operate from the rear, but her natural inclination is to race well back, and that combined with a fade in her debut finish tempers expectations significantly.

races.paceDynamic: Kanzi is the lone confirmed front runner in this seven-runner fillies' novice contest over Lingfield's AW mile and will set a sustainable, uncontested tempo from the front, with no genuine challenger likely to push her into a fast gallop early. Amethyst Star is the only other prominent-style runner and will track Kanzi in second, meaning the pace is unlikely to be truly searching — creating a scenario where the race may be decided by who quickens best from a compact, bunched field in the straight rather than who stays best from a genuine test. Norfolk Dream, Senorita Luna, and Chaise Longue are genuine hold-up types who will race at the rear, though Chaise Longue has been redistributed to midfield on the map because the field holds more hold-up horses than the pace shape can accommodate at the back. This controlled, single-pacemaker tempo on a flat AW mile strongly favours prominent racers or well-positioned midfield types who can travel into the race and quicken in a relatively small field — true closers will need the gallop to be stronger than Kanzi is likely to set.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kanzi Controls, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Kanzi leads at a comfortable clip and the field strings out behind Amethyst Star without pressure, rewarding tracked positions.
scenarios.body: Kanzi dictates from the front and the race develops into a procession until the home straight, where those racing prominently have first run on the tiring hold-up horses. Amethyst Star, ideally placed throughout, and Kanzi herself are the primary beneficiaries of this shape given their natural positions close to the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Storm Late
scenarios.trigger: If Kanzi goes quick enough early to set a true gallop and genuine closers find a fast-finishing lane in the straight.
scenarios.body: A strong early tempo from Kanzi would compress the pack and set up the race for horses coming from off the pace, allowing Norfolk Dream or Senorita Luna to make meaningful late headway. Both have hold-up profiles on similar going at Lingfield and would need this scenario to be competitive, though their sim-going records here show no wins or places.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unexposed Types Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ozone Friendly or Saffron Bay, both lightly raced and unknown quantities, show sharp improvement on debut or near-debut runs to upstage the experienced runners.
scenarios.body: Unraced or lightly raced fillies with unknown styles are wildcards whose raw ability could transcend the pace shape entirely, and either could slot into a prominent or midfield role that suits the controlled tempo. This scenario is entirely dependent on unseen ability outweighing experience and is inherently unpredictable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaise Longue Lands Blow
scenarios.trigger: If Chaise Longue, a genuine hold-up type pushed into midfield on the map, gets an unusually strong pace and produces a clean finishing run from off the pace.
scenarios.body: This scenario is markedly discounted because Chaise Longue is racing out of her natural rear position and her recent form figure of 8 on good ground offers little confidence; she fades in finishes and needs a stronger tempo than Kanzi is likely to provide. Even if she improves on that effort, the race shape is not set up to deliver the result she needs.

watchPoints.text: Watch Kanzi's early gallop — if she slows to a crawl after the first two furlongs, the prominent pair will be very hard to beat and true closers like Norfolk Dream and Senorita Luna will have nothing to chase.

Chaise Longue is tagged as a hold-up type mapped to midfield; if Jason Watson attempts to force her forward against her nature, she may use energy early and empty late — monitor her position leaving the stalls.

Ozone Friendly and Saffron Bay are both lightly raced unknowns with no going or style data — either could run into a forward position and disrupt the expected pace shape if they show natural early speed.

Norfolk Dream and Senorita Luna share a 0W0P record at Lingfield AW on Standard going from their only starts here — both need something to change dramatically in this race for those records to be reversed.

races.name: Hewanorra Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Rogue Supremacy
runners_data.note: Hold-up profile dropping back to 7f on standard AW, trainer Archie Watson has a poor 14-day strike rate (2/20); similar-going form shows no wins from 15 runs, making this an uphill task without a significant pace collapse to exploit.
runners_data.comment: Rogue Supremacy arrives here 25 days fresh, with experience of today's trip and going, and our rating of 94 marks him out as the one to beat among these seven. Winless in his last six starts, though a third six starts back hints at capability — stall three and 135 lb are his key tests.

runners_data.name: Arantes Nascimento
runners_data.note: Won over this exact course, distance and going (1/7f/STA), making this statistically the best surface and trip match in the field; Benoit de la Sayette rides for a yard with one win from 14 recently but the course form here is a genuine standout angle.
runners_data.comment: Two placed efforts prior to his latest start, Arantes Nascimento has solid recent form and brings distance and going experience to the table; the sixth last time out is the flag to watch, though 28 days since that run suggests connections are confident he returns sharp.

runners_data.name: Tattie Bogle
runners_data.note: Consistent front-to-prominent racer who has placed six times in recent starts including a win over a mile on good ground; drops to 7f AW here which may sharpen him up, and the headgear (p) was worn when placing at Goodwood — Charlie Johnston's yard has strong recent form at 5/44 (14-day).
runners_data.comment: Tattie Bogle has placed twice in his last three starts — second last time out and a winner four starts back — yet he ranks sixth of seven on our figures, making him difficult to fancy at the weights despite having experience of today's distance and going.

runners_data.name: Red Hat Eagle
runners_data.note: Carries strong hold-up tendency but cannot secure the rear in this field given the volume of genuine closers; placed at Goodwood over 7f, but five recent runs on good ground raise a query about whether he reaches his peak on standard AW going, and the positional compromise is a real tactical cost here.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts, Red Hat Eagle does at least bring experience of today's distance and going, and 28 days between runs suggests he arrives fresh; however, a sequence of mid-pack finishes and a mark of 72 make it hard to fancy him strongly against this field.

runners_data.name: Bold Suitor
runners_data.note: Nine-year-old who has won three times on this surface over 7f and carries the best AW-specific course record in the field (15/15 runs on standard going, 3W9P); his natural prominent role is squeezed by Arantes Nascimento and Tattie Bogle, and at a 59-day absence the layoff is the key risk against fresher rivals.
runners_data.comment: Bold Suitor won two starts back but has finished fifth on his most recent outing, and ranked last on our figures in a field of seven, he looks up against it here despite having experience of today's distance and going.

runners_data.name: Huscal
runners_data.note: The sole front-runner, Jason Watson can dictate on a tongue-tie first application over course and distance; his recent form has been on good ground (0W2P from 3 runs on standard) and stepping back up to 7f from 8f experiments may help, but the standard-going record is thin for a horse expected to lead throughout.
runners_data.comment: Huscal has been knocking on the door, finishing second last time out and third two starts back, and he has run over today's trip before; at 140 lb from stall 6, the weight could blunt a challenge from a gelding yet to win in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Port Road
runners_data.note: Boasts the most compelling surface profile in the race — 13 of 15 career runs on standard going, three wins, seven places; last won here over 7f on standard and returned an 8th and 6th in between, suggesting he is a consistent hold-up performer who needs the prominent runners to come back to him in the closing stages.
runners_data.comment: Port Road won two of his last five starts, including a victory three starts back, and has experience of both today's trip and conditions — he arrives fresh on 28 days off and his 137 lb burden from stall seven is the main worry.

races.paceDynamic: Huscal is the confirmed front-runner and will set a sustainable, uncontested gallop from the gates over Lingfield's 7f AW straight, with Jason Watson able to dictate terms at whatever tempo suits. Arantes Nascimento and Tattie Bogle are natural prominent racers who will press up behind Huscal, creating a two-tier lead group rather than a contested speed duel, which means the pace is likely to be honest but not punishing. Port Road and Rogue Supremacy will operate from hold-up positions and need the pace to be strong enough to close into, while Red Hat Eagle and Bold Suitor — genuine hold-up and prominent types respectively — are mapped out of their natural slots because the field cannot accommodate all of them in their preferred positions, with Arantes Nascimento and Tattie Bogle the likeliest to actually secure the prominent berths ahead of Bold Suitor. The race shape favours horses who can track the leader smoothly in second or third and sustain their effort over the final two furlongs, making the prominent-to-midfield profile the most advantaged, particularly those with proven form on this surface.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Huscal Controls, Prominent Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Huscal leads at a measured clip and the race unfolds without a serious pace challenge, allowing the prominent trackers to pounce.
scenarios.body: Huscal sets a controlled standard-going tempo and the horses ridden prominently in second and third have first run at the two-furlong marker; horses with Lingfield AW form and proven stamina over 7f on this surface are ideally placed to exploit the rhythm. Arantes Nascimento, who won here over 7f on standard going, and Tattie Bogle, a consistent placer, are perfectly positioned to nail the weakening leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closers Finish Fast
scenarios.trigger: If Huscal's lead becomes too comfortable and a lack of genuine pace compression allows the hold-up horses to close powerfully in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Port Road, a three-time winner on this surface with strong standard-going form, times a run from the rear to catch the prominent horses who hit the front too soon; Rogue Supremacy, though out of form, could also pick up late if the pace is truly modest and there is ground to make up. This shape requires the early gallop to be slow enough to bunch the field, which is possible but not the most likely outcome given Huscal's tendency to find a reasonable cruising speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Front Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Huscal burns off rivals by setting a surprisingly strong early gallop that breaks the field up within three furlongs.
scenarios.body: The prominent horses are forced to commit early and the race becomes a test of stamina rather than tactical speed; any runner not prominent by halfway is out of the race. Huscal's headgear (tongue-tie) and Arantes Nascimento's strong record at this course and distance make them the most durable candidates if the race is run at a genuine clip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Burst, Traffic Issues
scenarios.trigger: If prominent horses crowd each other out of position and midfield runners find a clear run to produce a pace-aided burst late.
scenarios.body: Bold Suitor, though racing out of his natural role and mapped to midfield, is a proven 7f AW performer here with three wins on this surface and could benefit if gaps open; Red Hat Eagle faces similar positional compromise but has course experience. This scenario depends on positional disruption that is unlikely given a field of only seven runners on a wide AW straight.

watchPoints.text: Arantes Nascimento's win record over this exact course and distance on standard going makes him the primary beneficiary if Huscal leads at a fair but not punishing pace — watch for Benoit de la Sayette to slot in second or third and challenge before the final furlong.

Bold Suitor's 59-day absence is the key unknown — if the layoff has left him short of peak fitness, his prominent role will be harder to sustain over 7f and he may drop away inside the final furlong despite his excellent surface record.

Port Road is the most likely beneficiary if pace compression occurs in the final quarter-mile — watch whether Harry Davies can secure a clean passage from the rear, as any traffic disruption in a 7-runner field will cost him ground he cannot afford at this distance.

Huscal's standard-going form is limited (3 career runs, 0 wins, 2 places) — if the AW surface does not suit his action, he could be headed earlier than expected and flip the race into a different shape entirely, benefiting the closers rather than the prominent racers.

Tattie Bogle has run in headgear consistently when placing and drops from 8f to 7f, a trip where he placed at Goodwood — watch whether Callum Shepherd can settle him immediately behind Huscal and avoid being crowded by Arantes Nascimento at a crucial point in the race.

races.name: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Henry Tudor
runners_data.note: Trainer Mark Hoad sends out a 1/1 runner over the past 14 days and this horse won on its last start over 6f STA — however it is a genuine hold-up performer squeezed into a midfield slot it won't naturally get, and its sim-going record of 1W1P from 13 is moderate; the style displacement tempers its chance significantly.
runners_data.comment: A winner five starts back and carrying just 135 lb from stall 1, Henry Tudor has experience of today's trip and going and ran just 25 days ago; the concern is that he has finished seventh, eighth, ninth and ninth in his last four starts.

runners_data.name: Horus
runners_data.note: Wearing tongue-tie, trained by Michael Attwater (1/14 in the T14 window), and returning from 60 days off with a poor sim-going strike rate (0W1P from 15); a true closer who at least gets to race in its natural position here and has placed at 6f STA before.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and yet to recapture the fourth he posted four runs back, Horus does bring distance and going experience plus a rating edge over his mark, though 60 days off and stall 10 carrying 135 lb are the obvious questions connections must answer.

runners_data.name: Just King High
runners_data.note: Fitted with tongue-tie and blinkers, returning from 40 days off with a trainer who has gone 0/3 in 14 days; a genuine hold-up horse shunted into a midfield map position it is unlikely to reach in a front-runner-controlled race, limiting its realistic chance despite two placed efforts on similar going.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts, Just King High has at least shown some ability — a second in recent starts hints at better lurking — but that sequence of mid-to-rear finishes since is hard to ignore; he has experience over today's trip and going, returns from 40 days off carrying 135 lb from stall 3.

runners_data.name: Rainbow Sorbet
runners_data.note: Wears a visor and has a poor record on similar going (0W0P from 6 runs), trainer Best 0/5 in the T14 window; races as a closer and will likely be held up at the rear, needing an unlikely collapse from the front to get involved on a surface that has not suited it.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts, with two sevenths among recent efforts, Rainbow Sorbet faces a stiff task from stall nine carrying 135 lb — though she has run over today's trip and going before, and 25 days between runs suggests she arrives fresh.

runners_data.name: Roman Spring
runners_data.note: Six-year-old prominent racer for trainer Rachel Cook & John Bridger (1/10 in T14), whose sim-going record on Good is much better than on Standard (1W2P but only 2/15 on AW); can slot in directly behind A Lott Of Kane and is the most natural threat to the leader in the way this race is expected to unfold.
runners_data.comment: Roman Spring arrives here fresh enough at 18 days since his last run, with experience over today's trip and going and a third three starts back hinting at latent ability; yet winless in his last six starts, the main concern is whether he can finally convert that promise.

runners_data.name: Music And Song
runners_data.note: Flagged as a horse that fades in the finish, and a genuine hold-up type mapped to midfield in a field over-stocked with closers; has only raced at 10f on Good or Soft — stepping down sharply in trip and switching surface is a major unknown, making this a very difficult race to assess with no AW or sub-10f form to reference.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last six starts and ranked ninth of ten on our figures, Music And Song faces a stiff task here; she does have experience of today's going and comes in fresh enough at 19 days, but her recent string of eighths and fifths makes it hard to fancy her chances.

runners_data.name: Paint Your Palette
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type that fades late, moved forward on the map by necessity rather than style; placed in just one of three lifetime starts (all on Soft or Good) and has zero AW experience — trainer Osborne 3/16 in T14 is the one positive, but this runner carries the least form substance in the field.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last three starts and ranked bottom of the field on our figures, Paint Your Palette has a significant ratings gap to bridge; 60 days off is a concern too, though she has run over today's trip before and gets her chance from stall four.

runners_data.name: A Lott Of Kane
runners_data.note: The sole confirmed front-runner with 2 wins from 4 AW starts including two victories at this exact course and distance; Joey Haynes, trainer Banham 1/2 in T14, and only 9 days since last run — this horse controls the tactical shape of the race and its sim-going strike rate of 9/11 reflects strong AW affinity.
runners_data.comment: Quick return on a nine-day turnaround after winning last time out, and he has experience over today's trip and going — but a mark of 49 and a mixed recent record, including a fifth two starts back, suggest he faces a stiff test from stall 5 carrying 137 lb.

runners_data.name: Dr Ali
runners_data.note: Two wins from 15 on similar going including a 6f STA win, wears a visor, and trainer Jenkins 0/4 in T14; a genuine hold-up horse redistributed into midfield because of the crowded closer profile, so its strong course-surface record is somewhat neutralised by the likely inability to get its true running position.
runners_data.comment: Dr Ali has experience over today's trip and going, and that sole win five starts back — allied to a rating of 58 that has him narrowly top-rated — makes him the one to beat here, even if his last three runs have been modest.

runners_data.name: Edergole's Gift
runners_data.note: Fitted with tongue-tie and blinkers, trainer Allen 1/3 in T14, returning fresh at 17 days; closes from behind over 7f usually but is dropped to 6f here — 1W4P on similar going across 15 runs shows consistency without dominance, and from a natural rear position it needs a genuine pace collapse.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last six starts, Edergole's Gift returns after 17 days and has experience over today's trip and going, but a fifth last time out and a ninth two starts back highlight the inconsistency that makes her hard to trust from stall 8 off 135 lb.

races.paceDynamic: A Lott Of Kane is the sole confirmed front-runner and is expected to stride straight to the lead from the off, setting a sustainable gallop over the 6f Lingfield AW trip on a Standard surface. With no genuine rival likely to contest the lead hard, this race shapes as a controlled, front-runner's race where A Lott Of Kane can dictate margins and tempo throughout. Behind, the field is dominated by hold-up horses — Henry Tudor, Just King High, Dr Ali, Music And Song and Paint Your Palette are all genuine hold-up types who have been redistributed forward on the map because the field contains more closers than the race shape can accommodate; A Lott Of Kane and Roman Spring are the only runners realistically able to secure an early prominent berth. This shape strongly favours the prominent/front-running profile, with hold-up runners dependent on a pace collapse that the lone, uncontested leader is unlikely to provide.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kane Controls, Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If A Lott Of Kane leads uncontested and sets a measured, honest gallop that the closers cannot bridge.
scenarios.body: A Lott Of Kane, fresh off a 9-day turnaround with 2 wins from 4 starts on this exact surface, dictates throughout and has enough class advantage to repel late challenges; Roman Spring, able to track in second, is ideally placed to be the main threat.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closers Overcome Lone Leader
scenarios.trigger: If A Lott Of Kane sets a pace that proves fast enough to soften in the final furlong, allowing closers to run past.
scenarios.body: A Lott Of Kane's recent 9-day turnaround on soft-ish ground and prominent style may leave it vulnerable late if the pace is brisk; genuine hold-up performers like Dr Ali (2 wins from 15 on similar going, class at 6f STA) or Henry Tudor (winner last start, 6f STA) would be best placed to capitalise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Pull Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Roman Spring slots in directly behind A Lott Of Kane and the hold-up horses fail to close from their unnatural midfield positions.
scenarios.body: Roman Spring and A Lott Of Kane set a sound early gallop and the race becomes a two-horse battle from the 2f pole, with redistributed closers unable to mount a challenge from mid-division positions that are not their natural starting point.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos — Wide Open Finish
scenarios.trigger: If A Lott Of Kane is slow away or becomes unruly, removing the single pace anchor and creating a scrambled shape.
scenarios.body: Without a front-runner to control the tempo, several horses jostle for position and the race deteriorates into a rough-paced affair that suits whichever hold-up runner finds the clearest late run; Horus or Edergole's Gift, both genuine closers with recent 6f form, could emerge in a muddled finish.

watchPoints.text: A Lott Of Kane — if it breaks cleanly and establishes the lead uncontested by the first furlong, the entire race is set up for the prominent/front-running profile and closers will be chasing shadows.

Roman Spring — watch in the early stages whether it successfully tracks A Lott Of Kane in second; if it secures that slot it becomes the chief danger, but its poor AW sim-going record (2/15) is a red flag on this surface.

Henry Tudor and Dr Ali — both genuine hold-up horses with winning form on 6f Standard who have been redistributed forward; if neither can drop in naturally at the rear, their recent course-surface credentials become harder to convert into a result.

Music And Song and Paint Your Palette — both are stepping into unfamiliar territory (shorter trip, AW surface, fade-in-finish flags); monitor their early positions as any sign of greenness or poor starts will confirm them as non-factors in this shape.

Horus — the 60-day absence and tongue-tie on reappearance bears watching in the paddock and early strides; if it shows signs of rustiness, the already thin closer-beats-leader scenario weakens further.
